units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale estimated

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of the ceiling strip vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.16 px in all frames)
camera.lighting: scene lighting/shadows on the back wall change strongly over the clip (not camera motion)
camera.perspective: clear perspective although labelled 2D: the tank's near parts move faster in pixels than its far parts (drill tip 54.0, main body 51.8, rear track plate 50.9, claws ~44, far-side rear ~46 px/frame); the robot stands nearer the camera than the tank (feet at y~965 vs tank track bottom y=894). Ground plane: floor with white lane lines; the back wall is parallel to the image plane; horizon not visible (above the frame).

objects.name: tank_drill_robot
objects.description: large blue tracked robot vehicle: blue body cylinder with red top box and handle, blue drill arm with a dark conical drill pointing right, two dark C-shaped claws, brown/grey caterpillar tracks. The only coloured object (background is greyscale).
objects.motion: translates rightwards at constant pixel speed through the whole clip (no start/stop, no vertical motion: y drift < 1.5 px)
objects.visible_frames: 0-47 (frames 0-8 cut by the left image edge, 9-32 fully in frame, 33-47 cut by the right edge; gone at 48-49)
objects.reference_point: ref_x = main-body template point + 30 px (about the chassis mid-x), ref_y = middle of box (582.5). Moves 51.80 px/frame. Alternatives in the CSV: tip_x (54.02 px/frame), rear_plate_x_meas (50.89), body_x (51.80), left_x and box_center_x

pixel_speeds_px_per_frame.leftmost_visible_point: about 50 at frame 12, falling to about 46 at frame 45 (quadratic)

objects.apparent_length_px: 614 (frame 9) to 705 (frame 32) while fully in frame; grows over time because of perspective. Height constant at 623 px

objects.name: small_grey_robot
objects.description: small grey humanoid toy robot with a large semi-transparent mushroom/dome head on a short neck (dark cup under the dome), round body with a dark disc, ball-jointed arms and legs, big feet; walks leftwards with a walk cycle (turns from 3/4 view to side view and back)
objects.motion: walks left at a steady 8.40 px/frame (neck axis; residual of a linear fit <= 1.5 px); vertical bob of the head and neck about 20 px peak-to-peak (cup top 725-746 px; lowest at frames ~12 and ~49, highest at ~3-5, ~22-24 and ~42-43)
objects.visible_frames: 0-49, never occluded (it is in front of the tank in frames 22-36)
objects.reference_point: ref_x = body axis x (centre of the dark neck cup under the dome); ref_y = cup top + 154 px (estimated hip/pelvis height, the hip ball joints by eye in frames 0-4)
objects.size_px: height from dome top to lowest foot about 300-317 px (frame 0: 661.5 to 964, 302.5 px). Dome head about 120 px wide, about 77 px tall above the cup. Width with arms 100-230 px depending on pose
